sections.body: Children your age need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep. Sleep helps you grow and remember what you learned.
Moving your body every day keeps your heart and muscles strong. Run, dance, jump, play!
Brush your teeth twice a day, for about 2 minutes, to keep them healthy. 🪥
Make a chart: did you sleep well, play actively and brush twice today?
Experts suggest children aged 6–8 get an hour of active play a day. A regular bedtime routine helps sleep.

quiz.q: How often should you brush your teeth?
hints: It's more than once a day.
We eat breakfast in the morning and brush, and before bed we brush again. How many times is that?
quiz.explain: Brush twice a day: morning and night.

options: It helps you grow and remember
hints: What does your body do while you sleep?
Your brain is busy at night too.
After a good sleep, it's easier to learn and play. Why?
quiz.explain: Sleep helps your body grow and your brain remember what you learned.

quiz.q: Why is it good to move your body every day?
options: It keeps your heart and muscles strong
It helps you stay up late
hints: Think about running, dancing and jumping.
Moving makes parts inside you work hard and grow strong.
Brushing keeps your teeth healthy. That is what brushing does. What does moving do?
quiz.explain: Running, dancing and playing keep your heart and muscles strong.
